findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document via `self.repo.get(doc_id)` without an ownership check (`user_id` unused), letting any authenticated user rename another user's document (IDOR/authorization bypass).
Skipping the `_owned` check also skips the `NotFound` response for non-owned documents, so callers can learn which doc ids exist, violating the documented no-id-disclosure guarantee.
`rename` validates the title before checking ownership, so a non-owner with an invalid title gets `ValueError` instead of `NotFound`; error ordering is inconsistent with other methods.
